About Nilora Resort

A Destination Designed for Every Traveller

Set amongst beautifully landscaped grounds in the heart of Port Macquarie, Nilora Resort offers spacious self-contained villas and premium resort facilities on the Mid-North Coast of NSW.

Whether you're planning a family holiday, corporate retreat, wedding accommodation, sporting event stay or a relaxing coastal getaway, Nilora Resort provides everything you need in one destination.

Facilities

Everything You Need,
All In One Place

Enjoy a wide range of resort facilities designed for relaxation, recreation and connection.

Lagoon Water Feature

Our stunning lagoon is a beautiful decorative centrepiece, offering a breathtaking tropical setting perfect for photos and relaxation by the water's edge.

Please note: The lagoon is a decorative feature and is not suitable for swimming.

Open Daily: 7:00 AM – 9:00 PM

Indoor Heated Pool

Heated year-round for comfortable swimming regardless of the weather outside.

Open Daily: 6:00 AM – 9:00 PM

Spa & Sauna

Unwind and rejuvenate in our spa and sauna facilities, perfect after a day of exploring.

Open Daily: 7:00 AM – 8:00 PM

Fitness Centre

Stay active with modern cardio and strength equipment in our fully equipped fitness facility.

Open Daily: 5:30 AM – 9:00 PM

Tennis Courts

Full-size tennis courts for all skill levels. Racquets available for hire at reception.

Open Daily: 7:00 AM – 9:00 PM

Games Room

Billiards, table tennis and arcade games. Perfect for rainy days and family entertainment.

Open Daily: 8:00 AM – 10:00 PM

BBQ & Outdoor Dining

Multiple BBQ areas with outdoor dining settings for memorable alfresco meals.

Available: 7:00 AM – 9:00 PM

Free On-Site Parking

Complimentary secure parking for all guests. No daily fees or time limits.

Available 24 Hours

Reception Services

Our friendly team is here to assist with local tips, bookings and anything you need during your stay.

Monday – Sunday: 7:00 AM – 10:00 PM

    FAQ

    Frequently Asked Questions

    Standard check-in is from 2:00 PM and check-out is by 10:00 AM. Early check-in and late check-out may be available upon request, subject to availability and additional charges may apply.

    Yes, Nilora Resort offers complimentary on-site parking for all guests. Parking is available directly adjacent to your villa or in designated resort parking areas.

    Unfortunately, pets are not permitted at Nilora Resort with the exception of certified assistance animals. Please contact us directly if you require assistance with pet-friendly accommodation alternatives in the area.

    Our standard cancellation policy allows for free cancellation up to 7 days prior to arrival. Cancellations within 7 days of arrival may incur a fee of one night's accommodation. Some promotional rates are non-refundable. Please check at the time of booking.

    Yes, all our two and three-bedroom resort villas are equipped with fully self-contained kitchens including stovetop, oven, microwave, dishwasher, refrigerator and all essential cookware and utensils. Our one-bedroom resort rooms include kitchenette facilities.

    Nilora Resort is centrally located in Port Macquarie, just minutes from some of the region's most beautiful beaches including Town Beach, Flynns Beach and Oxley Beach. Many beaches are within a 5–10 minute drive from the resort.

    Yes, complimentary high-speed WiFi is available throughout all resort accommodation and common areas. Details for connecting to the network will be provided at check-in.

    A premier coastal resort destination offering luxury villas, premium facilities and unforgettable experiences in the heart of Port Macquarie, NSW.
